Name: Player Status System-Beta
Author: jkysa88
Description:
[list=1]
[*]﻿Player Status System – Hunger, Fatigue & Illness for the FarmerThis mod adds a [b]fully configurable status system[/b] to the farmer: hunger, fatigue, illness, environmental hazards, allergies, hangovers, and more.
[/list]Instead of simple “flat penalties,” it tracks how you eat, sleep, work, and move through the world and applies [b]contextual debuffs[/b] when you push your luck for too long.
If you want your Stardew farmer to feel more like a real person—with good days, bad days, and consequences for bad habits—this mod is for you.
[quote][b]Status:[/b] Currently in a [i]beta-style release[/i] for balance and feedback.
Core systems are stable, but numbers and details may change based on player reports.[/quote]

Recommended Mod for Players Seeking a More Challenging Experience:[url=http://]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38938[/url]
This mod allows for a more realistic portrayal of in-game friendships.

[line]Core Features[list]
[*][b]20+ unique status effects[/b], each with its own icon, rules, and tuning.
[*][b]Food & digestion system[/b]: overeating, stomach trouble, malnourished state, sugar spike & crash, lactose intolerance.
[*][b]Illness & temperature system[/b]: colds, flu, heatstroke, chill, hypothermia.
[*][b]Fatigue & sleep system[/b]: fatigue from overexertion, sleep deprivation from poor sleep over multiple days.
[*][b]Injuries & allergies[/b]: muscle pain after heavy work, hand injuries from clumsy tool use, food-based allergies.
[*][b]Environmental hazards[/b]: desert dryness, winter chill, sewer smell with friendship impact.
[*][b]Harvey clinic integration[/b]: pay Harvey to cure your conditions instead of magically waking up fine.
[*][b]Full GMCM support[/b]: enable/disable each status, adjust chances, durations, damage, and severity in detail.
[*][b]SFX & visual feedback[/b]: optional cough/breathing/ambient sounds, glow effects, and status HUD icons.
[/list][line]Status Categories1. Food & DigestionHandle what you eat—and what you [b]don’t[/b] eat:
[list]
[*][b]Overeating[/b]
Eat too much in a short in-game window and you’ll become sluggish.Configure:[list]
[*]Time window (in-game hours)
[*]Count for “main meals” vs “snacks”
[*]Movement speed penalty
[*]Duration
[/list][*][b]Stomach Trouble (Stomach)[/b]
Spoiled food, bad food, or irritating food can cause stomach issues:[list]
[*]Reduces health/stamina gained from food
[*]Lasts a configurable duration
[*]Has an “irritation score” threshold that makes future stomach trouble more likely
[/list][*][b]Malnourished[/b]
If you maintain a [b]bad diet for several days in a row[/b], you enter a long-term malnourished state:[list]
[*]Reduces [b]max health[/b] and [b]max stamina[/b]
[*]Duration and severity are configurable
[*]Designed as a “slow punishment” for consistently poor eating, not a random surprise
[/list][*][b]Sugar Spike & Crash[/b]
Sweet foods cause:[list]
[*]A short [b]speed buff[/b] (sugar spike)
[*]Followed by a [b]crash[/b] with speed and recovery penalties
Both durations, speed bonus/penalty, and recovery penalties are configurable.[/list][*][b]Lactose Intolerance (optional)[/b]
In the dedicated [b]Lactose[/b] section:[list]
[*]Dairy (milk, cheese, etc.) can always trigger stomach trouble
[*]You can tune duration and severity multipliers separately from normal stomach issues
[/list][*][b]Spoiled Food System[/b]
Food items gain a simple “expiration” mechanic:[list]
[*]After a configurable number of days, items become [b][Spoiled][/b]
[*]Shortly before that, they show [b][Almost Spoiled][/b]
[*]Optional confirmation prompt before eating spoiled food
[/list][/list][line]2. Illness & WeatherWeather and exposure matter:
[list]
[*][b]Cold[/b]
[list]
[*]Chance to catch a cold after enough time in the rain
[*]Separate [i]base chance[/i] when your overall condition is poor, even without heavy rain
[*]You can choose between fixed-duration colds or min/max day ranges
[/list][*][b]Flu (SeriousFlu)[/b]
[list]
[*]Under bad conditions, a cold can worsen into flu
[*]Worsening chance, minimum/maximum duration, and rain exposure thresholds are fully configurable
[/list][*][b]Heatstroke[/b]
[list]
[*]Triggered by staying in hot environments for too long
[*]Deals HP over time and reduces effectiveness
[*]Threshold, duration, and damage per second are all adjustable
[/list][*][b]Chill & Hypothermia[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Chill[/b]: winter outdoor exposure leads to a gradual debuff
[*][b]Hypothermia[/b]: more extreme cold exposure with stronger penalties
[*]Both can increase your chances of catching a cold or flu via multipliers
[/list][/list][line]3. Fatigue & SleepThis mod tracks [b]how hard you push yourself[/b], not just your current energy bar:
[list]
[*][b]Fatigue[/b]
[list]
[*]If your stamina falls below a configured threshold, you accumulate fatigue
[*]Next day you may wake up with a fatigue debuff:
[list]
[*]Movement speed penalty
[*]Configurable duration
[/list][/list][*][b]Sleep Deprivation[/b]
[list]
[*]Nights where you sleep less than “okay” hours accumulate [b]sleep debt[/b]
[*]Falling under a severe threshold repeatedly can trigger a sleep-deprived status
[*]Tune:
[list]
[*]“Slept enough” hours
[*]“Severe lack of sleep” hours
[*]Cumulative sleep debt required
[*]Duration and speed penalty
[/list][/list][/list][line]4. Injuries, Allergies & Environment[b]Injuries & allergies:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Muscle Pain[/b]
[list]
[*]Comes from overworking your body in a day
[*]Lasts between configurable min/max days
[*]Comes with a speed penalty
[/list][*][b]Hand Injury[/b]
[list]
[*]Using tools clumsily or with low skill can injure your hand
[*]Chance, duration, and skill threshold are all configurable
[*]Slows work and makes tool use more punishing for beginners
[/list][*][b]Allergy[/b]
[list]
[*]Certain foods or triggers can cause an allergy debuff
[*]Simple chance, duration, and debuff behavior controlled via GMCM
[/list][/list][b]Environmental statuses:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Desert Dryness (DesertDry)[/b]
[list]
[*]Staying too long in dry regions (like the desert) drains HP and causes a dryness status
[*]Threshold, duration, and HP-per-second damage are configurable
[/list][*][b]Winter Chill (Chill)[/b]
[list]
[*]Long exposure in winter areas causes Chill with periodic HP loss
[*]Can interact with the cold/flu system via multipliers
[/list][*][b]Sewer Smell (SewerSmell)[/b]
[list]
[*]Staying near the sewers too long can give you a “you really smell” debuff
[*]Optional:
[list]
[*]Affect nearby NPC friendship over time
[*]Radius, HP impact, and daily friendship cap
[/list][*]Includes a dedicated cure option via the spa (if enabled)
[/list][/list][b]Status chaining:[/b]
[list]
[*]Optional [b]extra damage[/b] when certain bad combinations overlap, such as:
[list]
[*]Rash + Desert Dryness
[*]Rash + Plant Poison
Each chain has its own toggle and HP-per-second value.[/list][/list][line]Harvey Clinic IntegrationHarvey finally earns his keep.
When you talk to [b]Harvey inside the clinic[/b], and the farmer has at least one treatable status (e.g. stomach trouble, flu, heatstroke, malnourished):
[list]
[*]Harvey will offer to treat you for a fee.
[*]The fee is dynamically calculated based on:
[list]
[*]Which statuses you currently have
[*]Their category (mild vs serious vs long-term)
[/list][*]If you accept and can pay:
[list]
[*]The mod clears all clinic-treatable statuses
[*]Removes debuffs, icons, and glow effects tied to those statuses
[*]Resets internal counters related to irritation, fullness, and some chained effects
[/list][/list]If you cannot afford the treatment or refuse, Harvey responds appropriately and leaves you as you are.
All clinic text is fully localized (currently Korean + English) and easy to translate via the i18n files.
[line]Configuration (GMCM)This mod is built around [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for fine-grained control.
You can:
[list]
[*]Enable/disable each [b]individual status[/b] (e.g. turn off lactose intolerance or plant poison entirely).
[*]Adjust:
[list]
[*]Chance percentages
[*]Durations (real-time seconds/minutes or in-game days)
[*]HP-per-second damage
[*]Movement speed penalties/bonuses
[*]Thresholds (rain exposure, desert exposure, sleep hours, bad diet days, etc.)
[/list][*]Configure [b]which statuses persist after sleep[/b]:
[list]
[*]For each status, you can decide if it is reset by sleeping or only ends via duration or treatment.
[/list][*]Tune [b]environmental damage floor[/b]:
[list]
[*]Prevent environment damage from dropping HP below a certain value (or allow full knockouts).
[/list][*]Adjust all [b]audio options[/b]:
[list]
[*]Cough sounds
[*]Tired breathing
[*]Environmental/stench-related SFX
[/list][/list]Everything is grouped into logical sections (status system, environment, lactose, persistence, etc.) for easy navigation.
[line]Visual & Audio FeedbackTo make statuses feel tangible, the mod provides:
[list]
[*][b]Custom icons[/b] for each status in the HUD
[*]Optional [b]glow effects[/b] for severe conditions (flu, heatstroke, hypothermia, plant poison, etc.)
[*][b]Emotes and animations[/b] for certain events (stomach trouble, muscle pain, and more)
[*]Optional [b]sound effects[/b]:
[list]
[*]Coughing for colds/flu/allergies
[*]Heavy breathing for fatigue/sleep deprivation
[*]Ambient SFX for sewer smell and other special conditions
[/list][/list]All of these can be toggled or tuned via the config.
[line]Requirements & Compatibility[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI (current stable for 1.6)
[*]Content Patcher
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] – strongly recommended
[/list][b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]Designed to be broadly compatible with other mods.
[*]Uses Harmony patches primarily on:
[list]
[*][code]NPC.checkAction[/code] (Harvey in the clinic only)
[*][code]GameLocation.answerDialogueAction[/code] (custom clinic questions)
[/list][*]May conflict with mods that completely replace Harvey’s clinic interaction or heavily override those methods. In most cases it should coexist, but load order and patch details may matter.
[/list]No vanilla assets are permanently overwritten; everything is driven by code and i18n.
[line]Localization[list]
[*]Fully supports [b]English[/b] and [b]Korean[/b] out of the box.
[*]All player-facing text is in the [code]i18n[/code] files and can be easily translated into other languages.
[/list]If you’d like to contribute a translation, you can copy the English file, translate the values, and share it.
[line]Notes & FeedbackThis is a [b]feature-complete but balance-sensitive[/b] mod.
The core systems, conditions, and clinic integration are in place, but:
[list]
[*]Numbers may still be adjusted,
[*]Some edge cases may appear with heavily modded saves,
[*]Feedback on difficulty, fairness, and fun is very welcome.
[/list]If you encounter bugs, crashes, or strange behavior:
[list]
[*]Please include your [b]SMAPI log[/b],
[*]List which statuses you had at the time,
[*]And share your GMCM settings if relevant.
[/list]
